description: This file defines the Base64Attachment class which is a validation rule for handling Base64-encoded file attachments, including validation for file types, extensions, size, and filename length within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: Base64Attachment
classes.description: A validation rule class for verifying Base64-encoded file attachments with restrictions on type, extension, size, and filename length.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing validation parameters, with options for allowed types, extensions, filename length restrictions, size checking strictness, and maximum file size.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input array representing a file attachment, checking mandatory fields, type, extension, filename length, size, and content integrity.

methods.name: validateMin
methods.description: Checks if a filename length meets the minimum length requirement.

methods.name: validateMax
methods.description: Checks if a filename length does not exceed the maximum length.
